content.text: The existing minimum-temperature calculation only runs for evolving collision frequencies. I’ll make it available for constant frequencies too, then use it to initialize the cross-species floor with the proper DG normalization. Floored cells will still have their higher coefficients set to zero.

input.input:
text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('gyrokinetic/apps/gk_species_lbo.c')
s=p.read_text()
start=s.index('      double bmag_ref =',s.index('gk_species_lbo_init('))
end=s.index('\n      lbo->spitzer_calc',start)
block=s[start:end]
s=s[:start]+s[end:]
marker='    if (gks->info.collisions.self_nu) {'
s=s.replace(marker,'\n'.join(line[2:] if line.startswith('  ') else line for line in block.split('\n'))+'\n'+marker,1)
s=s.replace('// Floor the cell-average of vtSq_{sr} to zero, setting the rest of the coefficients to zero as well','// Floor vtSq_{sr} to the minimum representable value, zeroing higher coefficients when floored.')
s=s.replace('gkyl_array_clear(lbo->cross_vtsq_floor, 0.0); // Floor value of zero.','gkyl_array_clear(lbo->cross_vtsq_floor, 0.0);\n      gkyl_array_shiftc(lbo->cross_vtsq_floor, lbo->vtsq_min * pow(sqrt(2.0), app->cdim), 0);')
p.write_text(s)
p=Path('gyrokinetic/apps/gkyl_gyrokinetic_priv.h')
s=p.read_text().replace('// Zeroed array used to floor cross vtSq cell-average to >= 0.','// Minimum representable cross vtSq as a constant DG field.')
p.write_text(s)
PY
python3 ci/format.py gyrokinetic/apps/gk_species_lbo.c gyrokinetic/apps/gkyl_gyrokinetic_priv.h
